stem: Ken is not satisfied with his thesis statement in sentence 3. Which of the following should replace sentence 3 to provide a more effective thesis statement?

options.label: F
options.text: The AquaDom in Berlin, Germany, is very tall and made of glass; it is an experience that many people would like to have.

options.label: G
options.text: For a worthwhile experience, you should go to the AquaDom in Berlin, Germany; it is a unique attraction.

options.label: H
options.text: The AquaDom in Berlin, Germany, is a completely different kind of aquarium; it is a unique attraction that many people would love to experience.

options.label: J
options.text: The AquaDom in Berlin, Germany, is sort of a different kind of an aquarium; it is something many people would like to go see.
